svg.title: The end of the deadline
svg.desc: The last 110 ns of the round's wait. The kernel waits for the answer with a 1 microsecond timeout, plus 50 ns of feedback on the link, so the answer is due at 1450.5 ns. The dashed correction pulses on the data qubits start at that moment, whichever arm decides them.
